Huh, Iroiro seems to point out that there's an inconsistency among people drawing Momiji. Like, there are people who draw her without the dog ears 🤨 which personally is rather unimaginable. I don't think I've ever seen a Momiji art without the dog ears... Oh, [**Azmaya on AFiEU.**](https://en.touhouwiki.net/wiki/File:AFiEUMomijiArticle.jpg)

I love that big sword though.
